note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP Clinical Note, but I need the source materials. Please provide:

1) The raw transcript (doctor–patient conversation), verbatim if possible.
2) The DDx JSON from the diagnostic agent.

Once received, I will:
- Treat the transcript as the primary source.
- Use DDx to enrich differentials only when consistent (and mark conflicts if any).
- Avoid inferring any missing clinical facts.
- Output the note with the exact requested headings and bullet format.
